scope: All formal contracts have documented native executable profiles; finite native oracle evidence does not prove every input or every literature variant. The application uses the separately hashed execution gate.

operations.title: Look up entity records
operations.description: Native deterministic selection of original vertex records by typed IDs and AND field predicates. Explicit empty vertex lists select nothing. Missing fields match only exists=false; unknown field paths fail. Counts remain complete when row collections are capped.

operations.title: Filter relationship records and join endpoint attributes
operations.description: Native deterministic original-edge selection without collapsing loops or parallel events. Edge and source/target predicates use stored endpoints even for undirected input. Typed IDs, exact decimal scalar comparisons and explicit incomplete capped ports.

operations.title: Find nearby entities over selected relationships
operations.description: Native filtered hop reachability with exact distances. Directed out/in/both traversal; undirected edges traverse both ways. Parallel records do not duplicate vertices; include_seed controls the root. Original input vertex ordering and explicit collection completeness.

operations.title: Find the direct neighbors two entities share
operations.description: Native intersection of direct filtered neighbor sets, preserving the declared direction and self-loop adjacency meaning. Typed entity IDs; stable original vertex order. Complete count with explicitly capped collections.

operations.title: Find bounded connections between two entities
operations.description: Native iterative enumeration of all hop-shortest or all vertex-simple paths within max_hops. Filtered directed out/in/both traversal with parallel edge identities preserved. Source equal to target has one zero-edge path. Counts are exhaustive; capped path and membership ports are incomplete.

operations.title: Summarize recorded numeric values
operations.description: Native count, sum, average, minimum or maximum of an explicit field, grouped by a scalar field or vertex. Exact decimal rational arithmetic is authoritative; display values disclose rounding. Per-vertex edge groups include isolates and count loops once. Missing numeric/group fields fail. Stable exact-value sorting and completeness-aware result limits.

operations.title: Extract selected records as a graph
operations.description: Native vertex-induced, edge-induced or filtered-neighborhood extraction. Preserve typed IDs, original attributes, direction, weights, loop and parallel records. Edge mode retains endpoints; vertex mode retains selected isolates. Derived graph identity carries source content lineage.

operations.title: Learn vertex vectors from edge or walk context objectives
operations.description: Native second-order LINE or DeepWalk/node2vec fixed-window contexts, optimized with full-softmax cross entropy and declared L2 regularization. Weighted outgoing transitions preserve direction unless projection is requested. Explicit loop handling and summed parallel weights; every vertex receives source and context vectors. Report actual context masses, objective, gradient norm, seed and stopping reason; no global optimum or unique embedding claim.

operations.title: Learn typed directed triple scores with DistMult
operations.description: Native DistMult with mean logistic loss over declared training positives and fixed sampled corruptions, plus L2 regularization. Relations come only from the training split; duplicate triples collapse, distinct relation identities and self triples remain. Validation never affects fitting. Report entity/relation parameters, training examples and filtered head/tail ranking metrics with average ties; no unseen-relation inference.

operations.title: Train a graph-based vertex classifier or regressor
operations.description: Native simplified graph convolution: declared mean-message layers, then a trained linear softmax or scalar regression readout. Numeric vertex_features and training_labels use objects containing typed {vertex,value} rows. Disjoint train/validation/test IDs; preprocessing and loss use training labels only. Transductive unlabeled features/topology are explicit. Saved coefficients, split metrics, objective and convergence status; one self message, collapsed parallels, weights ignored.

operations.title: Train a permutation-invariant graph predictor
operations.description: Native independent per-graph mean message passing, sum/mean pooling, and trained linear softmax or scalar regression readout. Structural [one,in-degree,out-degree] or declared attribute features; empty graphs pool to zeros. graph_labels uses typed {graph,value} rows. Train-only fitted preprocessing and supervised loss, disjoint graph splits and saved model state. Weights ignored; no cross-graph edges.

operations.title: Learn vertex targets through the original hyperedge incidence
operations.description: Native hgnn-linear-v1: weighted hyperedge feature means followed by normalized vertex incidence means and a trained linear softmax/regression layer. No pairwise projection. Isolates retain features, singleton edges remain. Feature, target and split attributes are explicit; only train labels fit parameters or preprocessing. Record model state, finite predictions and metrics with split denominators. Optional model_parameters declare layers and optimizer settings.

operations.title: Propagate geographic seed locations under a geodesic objective
operations.description: Native spatial propagation by sequential discrete geodesic median coordinate descent. Minimize positive edge weight times spherical distance, restricting coordinates to seed locations in each connected component. Undirected nonnegative input, reject loops, sum parallels. Fixed seeds remain exact; seedless components remain unresolved. Haversine handles the antimeridian; report dispersion, stopping status and optional held-out geodesic errors. No supervised model or calibrated confidence claim.

operations.title: Learn synthetic graph features by matching supervised gradients
operations.description: Native gradient_matching_linear_sgc_v1 matches training softmax gradients at zero readout parameters. Learn synthetic features and fix class-balanced labels on declared edgeless adjacency; this is not graph coarsening. Original weighted SGC features use summed parallel weights plus self messages; reject original loops. Budget must cover training classes and not exceed training vertices. Train labels only, explicit transductive features/topology, new synthetic IDs. Evaluate full versus synthetic training on held-out original labels over declared seeds; report objective and utility variance.

operations.title: Rank graph entities against a declared reference
operations.description: Native structural and numeric features for vertices, original edge instances or supplied induced subgraphs. Population or explicit location/scale reference; weighted standardized L1, L2 or maximum deviation with declared minimum scale. Recompute scores, preserve zero-variance failures and disclose top-k truncation. Numerical deviation scores are not learned ground truth.

operations.title: Find candidate record pairs and resolve declared matches
operations.description: Complete native disjunctive blocking rules with equality, Unicode tokens, codepoint Levenshtein or exact numeric difference. ICU NFKC and full case folding; optional missing fields fail the predicate. Input edges are unused hints. Connected-components resolution or exact bounded minimum candidate-pair disagreement partitions; neutral noncandidates and no cross-component clusters.

operations.title: Compute minimum graph edit cost with an executable witness
operations.description: Exact bounded native partial correspondences over simple normalized directed or undirected graphs. Selected categorical vertex/edge labels; decimal rational costs. Vertex label replacement costs insertion plus deletion, edge substitution competes with deletion plus insertion. Returns normalized graphs and an ordered stable-handle script whose total is checked against the optimum. Weights and timestamps are ignored.

operations.title: Find the largest common graph by vertex count
operations.description: Exact bounded native induced matching, or label-compatible maximum vertex matching for non-induced output where isolated vertices are allowed. Preserve direction and selected categorical labels, ignore weights/timestamps. Returns a checked common graph and injective correspondence. No secondary maximum-edge objective. Explicit loop/parallel normalization.

operations.title: Aggregate vertices and edges into a weighted quotient graph
operations.description: Supplied integer partition or native greedy maximal matching; all vertices remain represented. Undirected nonnegative input, reject loops. Sum original parallel edge weights once, retain or drop intra-cluster edges, sum or mean feature vectors. Exact rational aggregates are reported separately from rounded binary64 graph values. Greedy partition has no optimality claim.

operations.title: Sample fewer edges and measure every Laplacian distortion direction
operations.description: Native effective-resistance sampling with replacement, exact rational draw normalization and importance reweighting. LAPACK grounded solves and all generalized eigenvalues measure numerical distortion; requested epsilon must pass. Explicit weighted undirected simple input, no loops/parallels. Preserve original IDs/attributes. Identity shortcut when budget covers positive edges, zero-weight edges removed. No probabilistic approximation guarantee is claimed.

operations.title: Mine patterns shared across graph transactions
operations.description: Exact bounded native enumeration of simple labeled directed or undirected patterns, including disconnected and isolated vertices. Support counts transactions once. Native lexicographic canonicalization has its own stable pattern IDs. Positive support fraction uses exact decimal comparison. Explicit loop and parallel policies; no Python runtime.

operations.title: Mine frequent labeled patterns within a graph
operations.description: Exact connected undirected patterns including single vertices. Minimum-image support is the smallest host image-set size over all injective embeddings. Every vertex needs the selected label or type. Reject loops; explicit parallel collapse. Native canonical IDs, bounded enumeration and complete counts; count mode does not materialize patterns.

operations.title: Count graph patterns with ordered edge events
operations.description: Exact native structural matching and injective event assignments. Rational UTC timestamps, acyclic partial order, inclusive duration limit, optional temporal inducedness and typed predicates. Event tuples in query-edge input order identify occurrences. Counts and vertex participation remain complete when instance lists are capped.

operations.title: Connect nearby feature vectors
operations.description: Native exhaustive pairwise Euclidean, squared Euclidean or cosine distances with self-exclusion and input-order tie breaking. Directed, union or mutual symmetrization. Cosine rejects zero vectors. Exact neighbor search under numerical distances even when approximate is requested; preserves typed vector IDs.

operations.title: Partition hyperedges directly with bounded vertex weights
operations.description: Exact native enumeration of nonempty parts, optimizing weighted cut-net or connectivity-minus-one without graph projection. Exact rational vertex and hyperedge weights, decimal imbalance tolerance and upper part-weight bound. Certified infeasibility when no partition qualifies; exponential search obeys work budgets.

operations.title: Find matches for a supplied graph pattern
operations.description: Exact native induced or non-induced injective matching, preserving direction, loops and parallel multiplicities. Declarative typed vertex and edge predicates; distinct query edges must match distinct data edges. Capped mapping collections are explicitly incomplete.

operations.title: Count supplied connected motifs
operations.description: Exact structural embeddings with explicit occurrence identity: all mappings or unique vertex-set and image-edge classes. Preserve direction; simple projections discard loops, duplicate edges and weights. Non-induced motifs on the same vertex set can be distinct instances. Counts remain complete when lists are capped.

operations.title: Count connected induced graph shapes and vertex roles
operations.description: Native isomorphism classification against the complete connected undirected graph atlas for sizes two through seven. Static atlas IDs and exact automorphism orbits are embedded; Python is not required. Discard loops and duplicate edges, ignore weights. Counts and optional orbit participation stay complete when memberships are capped.

operations.title: Connect representatives of every required group
operations.description: Exact bounded vertex-subset optimization with a minimum spanning tree for each feasible induced subgraph. Covers every group and required vertex, allowing overlapping representatives. Undirected nonnegative weighted input, loops removed, cheapest original parallel edge retained. Reports exact rational cost or certified infeasibility.

operations.title: Align two graphs while conserving edges and supplied similarities
operations.description: Exact bounded global injective assignment covering every vertex of the smaller graph. Maximize topology_weight times conserved edge value plus pair priors. Direction must match. Drop loops and collapse unweighted or sum nonnegative weighted parallel edges. Weighted conservation is the minimum of paired normalized edge weights.

operations.title: Choose seeds that maximize expected diffusion
operations.description: Exact rational live-edge and seed-set enumeration for independent cascade or random-threshold LT. Fixed LT thresholds use progressive activation, including spontaneous activation at zero. Directed input, explicit probabilities, loops removed. Parallel IC probabilities combine by independent failure; LT weights sum with incoming mass at most one. Exponential work is bounded; no sampling claims.

operations.title: Compare a statistic with a random graph ensemble
operations.description: Uniform G(n,m), or uniform stub pairing conditioned on simplicity and exact degree invariants. Dense fixed-degree graphs use complement sampling. Preserve direction, discard loops and collapse duplicates. Statistics: triangles, directed triangles, k-cliques, density or a supplied-partition modularity. Report every sample, population standard deviation and declared empirical tail; no hidden pseudocount.

operations.title: Track connected components and holes across edge thresholds
operations.description: Exact sparse boundary reduction of a flag complex over a declared prime field. Vertices start at zero; include cofaces needed to compute deaths in requested dimensions. Undirected input; reject loops, require nonnegative weights, keep minimum parallel filtration. Optional cutoff marks unpaired intervals right-censored.

operations.title: Find a community around required seeds
operations.description: Heuristic personalized-PageRank degree-normalized sweep with required seeds first. Returns the lowest defined weighted conductance among feasible prefixes. Exact cut/volume recomputation, no global-optimum claim. Undirected input; reject loops, sum nonnegative parallel weights. If all conductance denominators vanish, return the seeds.

operations.title: Compute a force-directed network drawing
operations.description: Native Fruchterman-Reingold iterations in two or three dimensions. Explicit 0.01 distance regularization, linear cooling from one tenth of the maximum coordinate span, no final rescaling. Recompute matching potential and uncooled force residual; no drawing optimality claim. Project direction, drop loops, collapse unweighted or sum weighted parallels.

operations.title: Compute Laplacian eigenvalues and eigenvectors
operations.description: Native LAPACK symmetric eigensolver with independently recomputed absolute residual and orthogonality checks. Combinatorial or symmetric-normalized Laplacian, including isolates. Undirected input; reject loops and negative weights, sum parallel weights. Dense solver uses work budgets; no iteration parameter.

operations.title: Smooth noisy measurements over a graph
operations.description: Minimize half squared signal error plus Laplacian quadratic, weighted total variation, or explicit graph-trend penalty. Native positive-definite solve or accelerated feasible-dual optimization; tolerance bounds objective gap, with a separate L2 solution-error bound. Undirected input, no loops, nonnegative summed parallel weights.

operations.title: Compare vertices by the similarity of their neighbors
operations.description: Native float64 SimRank fixed-point iteration with a recomputed contraction error bound. Incoming or undirected-projection neighborhoods; drop loops and duplicates, ignore weights. Single-source output excludes itself. Top-k ports explicitly disclose omitted pairs.

operations.title: Find the greatest bottleneck capacity from a source
operations.description: Exact max-min capacities with a predecessor witness, preserving direction. Every edge needs nonnegative capacity; loops discarded and largest parallel capacity wins. Zero is reachable. Source infinity and unreachable nulls have distinct flags.

operations.title: Find the highest-cost paths through a DAG
operations.description: Exact rational k-best DAG paths, retaining parallel edge identities and negative weights. Omitted sources and sinks select zero-in/out-degree vertices. A zero-edge path is included when a source is also a sink. Finishing top-k does not imply the path collection is exhaustive.

operations.title: Find earliest arrivals or fastest journeys through timed events
operations.description: Exact rational time-expanded shortest paths. Directed event input; every edge needs a timestamp and nonnegative duration attribute. Waiting is allowed. Fastest duration excludes waiting before initial departure. Inclusive ready time and deadline preserve distinct parallel events.

operations.title: Enumerate bounded simple paths or cycles
operations.description: Exact directed simple edge paths and cycles up to max_hops. Drop loops; collapse to first parallel edge or retain identities. Optional strict chronological order applies after canonical cycle rotation. A result cap retains the shortest sequences while the total count remains exhaustive.

operations.title: Divide a network into communities
operations.description: Undirected modularity or constant Potts objective. Exact mode enumerates partitions with rational objectives; heuristic mode uses seeded positive-gain vertex moves and makes no global-optimum claim. Drop loops and collapse unweighted or sum weighted parallel edges. CPM is internal edge weight minus resolution times within-part vertex pairs.

operations.title: Split a graph into balanced groups with few crossing edges
operations.description: Exact bounded partition search with nonempty parts and both lower and upper balance limits. Undirected input, nonnegative edge weights, loop removal and duplicate collapse or weighted sum. Normalized cut sums each part boundary divided by its declared balance size. Decimal-rational imbalance tolerance; exact objective and infeasibility certificates.

operations.title: Check balance or minimize frustrated connections
operations.description: Exact signed parity balance test and bounded rational frustration minimization. Every edge type is positive or negative. Undirected input; drop loops, reject contradictory parallel signs and collapse unweighted or sum weighted parallels. Zero-cost violations still make the network structurally unbalanced.

operations.title: Find the region with the most edges or cliques per vertex
operations.description: Exact induced k-clique count divided by vertex count. Weighted density is defined for clique_order=2, summing parallel weights. Undirected input; loops discarded. Native rational maximum-weight closure for minimum_vertices=1; bounded exhaustive cardinality search otherwise.

operations.title: Find exactly k vertices with the greatest internal edge value
operations.description: Exact bounded cardinality search. Sum parallel nonnegative weights, discard loops, require undirected input. An approximate request receives the stronger exact result when search completes.

operations.title: Find groups meeting a minimum internal-degree fraction
operations.description: Exact gamma quasi-cliques on an undirected simple projection. Thresholds use decimal-rational gamma; maximality is relative to all qualifying sets within the size bounds. Search is bounded by work and output budgets.

operations.title: Find completely connected groups across two sides
operations.description: Exact inclusion-maximal bicliques with nonempty sides. Explicit disjoint partitions must cover every vertex. Undirected input; loops discarded and duplicate edges collapsed. Capped memberships are marked incomplete.

operations.title: Count four-way connections between two sides
operations.description: Exact 2-by-2 biclique counts, participation and alpha/beta cores. Every vertex requires attributes.side=left|right. Reject directed input, loops and same-side edges; collapse duplicates. Core thresholds explicitly use degree or butterfly participation.

operations.title: Find which places can reach each other
operations.description: Exact reflexive reachability: every vertex reaches itself by a zero-length path. Preserve graph direction, ignore weights, loops and duplicates. Count-only closure has a complete scalar and incomplete pair-list port.

operations.title: Find overlapping tightly connected groups
operations.description: Exact k-clique percolation. Undirected simple projection; discard loops and duplicates. Communities can overlap. Unassigned vertices are outside all percolation communities before minimum-size display filtering.

operations.title: Connections within a number of steps
operations.description: Minimum hop distances with explicit independent or nearest-source searches. Preserve direction; discard loops and collapse duplicate arcs; weights are ignored. IDs are signed int64 or strings.

operations.title: Count or list triangles
operations.description: Count three-vertex cliques of an undirected graph. Discard loops and collapse duplicate edges; weights are ignored. GPU enumeration uses native CPU materialization with count verification.

operations.title: Shortest weighted paths from one vertex
operations.description: Nonnegative lengths; preserve direction, drop loops and keep minimum parallel length. CPU returns exact rational costs over admitted binary64 weights; GPU returns float64 costs. Cutoff is inclusive.
gpu_limitations: Path cost bounds must fit float64; integral costs beyond 2^53 require CPU

operations.title: Shortest paths between selected vertex sets
operations.description: Selected origins and destinations, or all vertices for null. Nonnegative lengths, minimum parallel length and preserved direction; CPU exact costs and GPU float64 costs.
gpu_limitations: Path cost bounds must fit float64; integral costs beyond 2^53 require CPU

operations.title: Minimum or maximum spanning forest
operations.description: Undirected weighted forests with isolates retained. Negative lengths are allowed. Keep minimum or maximum parallel weights according to the objective; discard loops.

operations.title: Connected vertex groups
operations.description: Weak or strong connectivity. Weak mode uses an undirected projection; strong mode preserves direction. Loops, duplicate edges and weights do not affect membership.

operations.title: Order a directed acyclic graph
operations.description: Return a deterministic topological order. Reject directed cycles, including self-loops. Duplicate arcs collapse; weights are ignored.

operations.title: PageRank influence scores
operations.description: Directed random-walk scores with uniform restart and dangling distribution. Drop loops, sum parallel weights and independently verify the fixed-point residual.

operations.title: Rank vertices by their number of connections
operations.description: Exact degree scores with outgoing, incoming, both or undirected-projection semantics. Drop loops, collapse duplicate edges and ignore weights. Optional normalization divides by n-1; isolates score zero.

operations.title: Rank vertices that connect shortest paths
operations.description: All-source betweenness excluding endpoints. Preserve direction, drop loops and keep minimum parallel length. CPU supports exact rational scores and strictly positive weighted paths; GPU profiles use unweighted paths with declared floating-point arithmetic.

backends.execution: not linked in this standalone build

gpu_limitations: Unweighted paths only
Original turbo-bc supports undirected graphs and uses float32 accumulation; libcugraph supports either direction
Shortest-path counts must fit signed int32; larger inputs receive bounded CPU admission checks

operations.title: Restart walks around seed vertices
operations.description: Seeded PageRank with explicit direction, weight and dangling policies. Full score port stays complete when the displayed ranking is filtered or capped.
gpu_limitations: Custom uniform dangling redistribution uses the CPU profile

operations.title: Score potential links from local neighborhoods
operations.description: Undirected simple neighborhoods; loops and weights ignored. CPU supports eight local measures; GPU supports Jaccard. Candidate limits apply before top_k; capped output is explicitly incomplete.
gpu_limitations: Only scoring_measure=jaccard

operations.title: Find a non-conflicting group that cannot be extended
operations.description: Greedy maximal independent set with verified independence and maximality; no maximum-size claim. Undirected simple projection; discard loops and duplicate edges, ignore weights and preserve isolates.

operations.title: Assign different colors to nearby vertices
operations.description: Proper greedy distance-1 or distance-2 coloring; no minimum-color claim. Undirected simple projection with isolates preserved. GPU colors the native C++ constructed distance conflict graph.

operations.title: Generate walks from chosen vertices
operations.description: Uniform, weighted or node2vec walks with length measured in transitions. Preserve direction and loops. Uniform walks collapse parallel neighbors; weighted walks sum parallel weights. CPU probabilities use exact rational arithmetic. Repeated starts produce separate walks.
gpu_limitations: Uniform and weighted models; node2vec uses exact native CPU
Dense allocation must fit the output budget; positive normalized weights must not underflow float64

operations.title: Sample connections around starting vertices
operations.description: Outgoing edge-instance sampling with hop and seed-batch provenance. Support uniform or exact weighted draws, replacement, typed fanouts and inclusive time cutoff. Fanout -1 includes every eligible edge, including zero-weight edges; loops and parallel identities are retained.

operations.title: Extract a graph around selected vertices
operations.description: Exact induced or ego subgraph, preserving typed IDs, edge instances and properties. Ego radius includes all vertices within that distance. Direction affects discovery only; output retains original edge direction. GPU ego discovery uses libcugraph BFS with native materialization.
gpu_limitations: GPU ego discovery; explicit induced selection uses native CPU

operations.title: Find capacity and bottlenecks between two places
operations.description: Exact rational flow and cut certificate. Sum parallel capacities, discard loops and treat undirected edges as two directed arcs. Optional vertex capacities use typed {vertex,capacity} records and include explicitly limited terminals. Mixed cuts return original edge IDs plus cut vertices.

backends.execution: isolated original CUDA flow worker with native exact flow and cut certification

gpu_limitations: ecl-maxflow: nonnegative integral normalized capacities with total <=1e9; no vertex capacities
At most 1M vertices and 10M input edges; exact residual flow/cut certification

operations.title: Find the highest-value non-conflicting pairs
operations.description: Exact maximum-weight matching on an undirected graph, with no cardinality constraint. Require nonnegative weights; discard loops and keep the largest parallel weight. Preserve selected original edge IDs and return exact rational totals over admitted binary64 weights. Zero-weight edges may be omitted.

operations.title: Match items on two sides by count, value or cost
operations.description: Exact cardinality, weight or cost matching with attributes.side=left|right on every vertex. Reject same-side edges and loops; keep the best parallel edge. Weighted objectives require explicit weights. Without required smaller-side coverage, empty matching may be optimal. Infeasible coverage has no witness port.

backends.execution: isolated original CUDA assignment worker with native exact optimality verification

gpu_limitations: hungarian-cuda: minimum-cost perfect assignment, complete equal sides, at most 64 per side
Every input cost must be an integer in [0,999]; native C++ verifies the optimum

operations.title: Find complete groups that cannot be extended
operations.description: Exact maximal cliques in an undirected simple projection. Drop loops and duplicate edges; ignore weights. Original GPU kernels supply a count, with bounded C++ materialization and explicit list completeness.

backends.execution: not linked in this standalone build
not linked in this standalone build
not linked in this standalone build

gpu_limitations: GPU count plus bounded native materialization
A forward-subset count bound must fit uint64

operations.title: Find the largest fully connected group
operations.description: Exact maximum clique, optionally all tied optima. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. Original GPU witnesses are checked by native coloring or exact search; ties use native materialization.

operations.title: Count or list complete groups of a chosen size
operations.description: Exact count for k>=2 with no upper k bound on CPU. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. GPU counts require supported k and a uint64 count bound. Counts remain complete when memberships are capped.

A forward-subset count bound must fit uint64

operations.title: Find fragile connections and cut vertices
operations.description: Exact vertex-biconnected edge blocks, bridges and articulation vertices. Undirected input; loops discarded and parallel edges collapsed. Every normalized edge keeps its first original ID and all source edge IDs.

operations.title: Find connections supported by triangles
operations.description: Complete edge truss numbers using the k-2 support convention, plus optional k-truss selection. Undirected simple projection, weights ignored. First original edge IDs represent collapsed edges; source IDs are retained.

operations.title: Find the well-connected core
operations.description: Exact core numbers and optional selected vertices. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. Isolates have core number zero.

operations.title: Find the largest non-conflicting group
operations.description: Exact maximum independent set via maximum clique of the complement. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. Complement construction and search are bounded.

operations.title: Cover every connection with as few vertices as possible
operations.description: Exact minimum vertex cover, or decision against k, from a maximum independent set. Undirected simple projection; loops, duplicate edges and weights ignored. Native complement construction and search are bounded.
